title: Brimstone
description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and ALL enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic triggers at the start of each combat turn. It grants the player 2 Strength while simultaneously granting 1 Strength to all alive enemies. The benefit outweighs the cost since the player gains twice as much Strength, but it does strengthen the opposition.
